description.value:
Requirements You are not observed by any enemies

Effect You phase yourself into the interstices, veiling yourself from physical reality. You become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Concealed]. You can use this concealment to [[/act hide]] or [[/act sneak]] as your disassociation from reality makes you difficult to focus on. If you use a hostile action, this effect ends after the action is complete; otherwise, it lasts for 1 minute.
